definitions.explanation: A person or shop that makes or alters clothing to fit individual customers. Can refer to either the craftsperson or the establishment.

examples.japanese: {仕立屋|したてや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I ordered a suit from the tailor.
There's a skilled tailor in this town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}、{仕立屋|したてや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕立|した}て→仕立て：11645_shitate⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother learned kimono tailoring at a tailor's shop when she was young.

notes:
A traditional occupation word formed from ⟦{仕立|した}て→仕立て：11645_shitate⟧ (tailoring, sewing) + ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (shop/person). While dedicated tailor shops have become less common in modern Japan, the word is still used and understood.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕立屋|したてや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to send to the tailor
- {仕立屋|したてや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to commission a tailor
- ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{仕立屋|したてや}: a skilled tailor

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{仕立|した}てる→仕立てる：09525_shitateru⟧: to tailor; to sew — the verb form
- オーダー⟦メイド→メイド：12377_meido⟧: custom-made — the modern loanword alternative
- ⟦{洋裁|ようさい}→洋裁：20802_yousai⟧: Western dressmaking
- ⟦{和裁|わさい}→和裁：20825_wasai⟧: Japanese garment making
